desc: 暖陶砖红日光场景下的婴儿便携硬盖抽取湿巾，靠布面纤维与封层结构说服
leaf: 婴儿外出便携抽取式清洁湿巾（flow-wrap 软袋、宽面居中嵌入圆角长方硬塑翻盖、同门另有色号小袋）
name: 暖陶日光婴儿便携抽取湿巾款

shots.intent: 用低角度日光斜过长软影的暖陶展台，把带硬盖的软袋与立起的一片巾体交代清楚，在详情首屏赢下一眼点击。
shots.textZone: stacked headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in the left clay column with one word knocked out of a brick #B0503A highlighter block, sub-line 「{callout_1}」 beneath, and one vertical ghost-print glyph index at the right margin reading 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把随身清洁最常见的四条顾虑压成一列套印图形与短标签，一屏之内让家长对号入座，主张全部由占位符承载。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in the upper-left with one word knocked out of a brick #B0503A block, four stacked label placeholders 「{callout_4}」 beside the four ghost-print glyphs; every claim carried by a placeholder, nothing asserted as fact

shots.intent: 同机位同光双格侧影，让买家自己看见一次一张与连抽带出在硬盖开口处的差别，不写任何数据与徽标。
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_5}」 above and 「{callout_6}」 below at 13pt, headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in the upper band with one word knocked out of a brick block; no badges, no arrows implying data, no percentages

shots.intent: 用正俯视的三层层压剖面条带讲清袋体自身的阻隔结构，以可见构造替代一切功效与倍数承诺。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_4}」 with one word knocked out of a brick #B0503A block, three stacked layer labels 「{callout_7}」 at 13pt beside the peeled lips; no numerals, no layer-count digit, no multiple comparison figure rendered

shots.intent: 把小包湿巾放进真实外出动线的包袋一角，用低角日光与背影人物完成代入，同时不出现任何面孔与婴幼儿。
shots.textZone: one small caption placeholder 「{callout_8}」 in deep cocoa #3F251E near the lower-right at 12pt, nothing else

shots.intent: 以斜射微距直视巾体的交叉铺纤维与水刺凹点，用可见织构承担品质证据，替代任何成分与数值表述。
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_9}」 at 13pt in the upper-left shadow zone, nothing else

shots.intent: 把同形不同规格与色号的三包一次铺满一屏，消除规格疑问并抬升连带，规格名一律留作占位标签。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_5}」 in the top band with one word knocked out of a brick block, three short spec labels 「{callout_10}」 under each pack at 13pt; no piece count, no millimetre, no month figure rendered

shots.intent: 用一张印在陶场上的空参数卡与一枚空提示框承接规格与信息位，把全部数字交回占位符，不写任何数值与备案号。
shots.textZone: card title 「{callout_11}」 at 20pt with six stacked empty parameter rows 「{callout_12}」 at 13pt and one blank caution frame 「{callout_13}」 left unfilled; all values are placeholders and no digit is rendered

shots.intent: 以俯角收口与一枚短按钮把浏览转成加购动作，主张与优惠全部留白，只靠版面节奏结束详情页。
shots.textZone: brick band carries the closing line 「{selling_point_6}」 at 30pt in cotton #F9EDE7 with one word knocked out in brick from a cotton block, plus a short CTA pill reading 「{callout_14}」 at 18pt and one supporting line 「{callout_15}」 at 12pt; no price, no discount, no countdown

style.presentationRules: the pack is always a sealed flow-wrap pillow pouch shown standing on one crimped end seam, laid flat on its back seam, or propped at a single gentle lean, with the rounded-rectangular hard-plastic hinged lid inset in the middle of its wide printed face, its thumb tab turned to the near camera-facing edge and its hinge line on the far edge, both crimped heat-seal flanges and both pleated end fins intact; the printed lid panel and the printed wide face stay blank legible fields in their reference positions and are never re-lettered, re-scaled, recoloured or restyled, and no arc, droplet or badge element from the reference artwork is ever reused as an icon or as a data mark; a sheet is always a thick cross-laid spunlace nonwoven with visible individual fibre tips, never paper, tissue or a smooth pulp film, and is only ever shown raised from the aperture, fanned, folded or held in light tension on an inert rig, never touching skin and never held by a hand; product scale, pack colour and lid geometry stay constant across the set and every unit is grounded by its own long soft forward shadow; the pack is never re-sculpted into a rigid tub, a pump bottle, a spray trigger or a slim sachet, never shown lid-off, never opened wider than one sheet and never shown in a colourway the reference does not carry
